## memory_correct — Write, run with call_write

## memory_recall — Read, run with call_read
Read facts from memory, as of now or `asOf` a past date, from one `space`, several `spaces`, or (neither) every space you can see. In `query` put every other word for what you want (synonyms, abbreviations, full names) in one search instead of searching again; `subject` lists a subject's facts. Facts come one per line under their subject, led by a handle (f12) for memory_correct and memory_forget; a heading says when it shows all the subject's current facts. Answer from current facts unless asked about the past; includeHistory adds ended and corrected ones (when or why X changed). Pass a returned cursor back as `cursor` for more.
